title: EXIT
description:
Reminder: If you feel dizzy, you can adjust the shaking degree in the setting

Searching for anomalies through a strange phone, finding details, and ultimately "successfully" escaping this nightmare cycle from the "safe exit"

Players need to identify the anomalies in each loop in order to continue moving forward, otherwise some bad things may happen

But upon careful consideration, why are you here, what is your purpose, and who provided these guidelines.

Did you really escape in the end? What is the truth behind the cycle? Perhaps everything is not as simple as it seems to you, perhaps the escape you thought was not really escape, or perhaps escape was easy for you. And is that phone really trustworthy?
